subject: International transfer onboarding — UK addendum sequencing & TIA checklist
messages:
From: Alice Barnes <alice@heliohealth.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@heliohealth.com
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Initial TIA scoping & UK addendum sequencing for HelioHealth pilot

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency profile. We are starting procurement prep for a small pilot and need to lock down the transfer mechanics so our legal/compliance team can sign off. High-level asks: 

- Confirm which module of Redwood will run in-region (EU) vs. routed to the US hosted set.
- Can you share a draft UK Addendum with your proposed signing order (we typically need to get this in hand before the SOW)?
- We need a mapped TIA evidence matrix showing where logs / KMs / audit trails will be accessible for HelioHealth auditors.

We have a hard milestone to finish legal review by Nov 19 to meet the pilot start. Attaching a short intake form.

Appreciate a quick write-up of the recommended sequencing and any gating items.

Best,
Alice
Alice Barnes
Head of Legal Operations, HelioHealth
[Attachment: helio-tia-intake.pdf (PDF, 85 KB)]

From: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
To: Alice Barnes <alice@heliohealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, priyom_das@redwoodinference.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial TIA scoping & UK addendum sequencing for HelioHealth pilot

Alice — thanks, and great to be partnering on this. High-level response inline below and a proposed next-step plan attached. Short summary up front: we can support an EU-primary routing for inference; the hosted control plane will remain in our US region but we can offer a private Dedicated pool in eu-west-1 for the pilot to minimize cross-border model incurrence.

Quick sequencing we recommend (2-week sprint cadence):
1) Review draft UK Addendum (legal) — we attach our redline and ask Helio to confirm any additional clauses (PII carveouts, designated auditors).
2) TIA evidence mapping — our security team will deliver an evidence matrix tied to endpoints (S3 logs, access logs, audit exports).
3) Subprocessor attestation — we will provide the subprocessor map and any SOC2 scopes; we propose a targeted attestation for the pilot.
4) Signatures and DocuSign return + procurement PO.

Attachments: uk-addendum-draft.pdf (our redline), tia-evidence-matrix.xlsx (template). Will follow up with a short recorded walkthrough for your legal.

Next steps: Laura — can you confirm UK Addendum redline acceptance points? Prio — can you enumerate evidence that we can produce within 5 business days? Vivek — confirm Dedicated pool availability for Nov pilot window.

Thanks,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Legal & GTM Privacy
Redwood Inference
[Attachments: uk-addendum-draft.pdf (PDF, 210 KB); tia-evidence-matrix.xlsx (XLSX, 120 KB)]

From: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
To: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com, Alice Barnes <alice@heliohealth.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwoodinference.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 08:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial TIA scoping & UK addendum sequencing for HelioHealth pilot

Hi all — quick legal read. Two items HelioLegal commonly flags that I already redlined: 1) dual-hatted subcontractor language around telemetry exports, 2) a clarified retention carveout for debug logs. Both are standard but we'll need Helio to accept the retention max (90 days) or propose a business case for longer.

On attestation: we can commit to a scoped subprocessor attestation for the pilot that covers our hosting provider and telemetry processor; I will prepare the sign-off statement and include a link to the relevant SOC2 page.

I left tracked comments on the attached PDF — Alice, please check pages 3 and 7. If procurement wants to push earlier, we can fast-track the redlines and DocuSign by week-of Nov 15.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Data Protection
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: uk-addendum-draft.pdf (with tracked comments)]

From: priyom_das@redwoodinference.com
To: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, Alice Barnes <alice@heliohealth.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 10:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial TIA scoping & UK addendum sequencing for HelioHealth pilot

Hi — technical evidence summary below, pulled from the matrix: 
- Audit logs: full request/response metadata stored in our EU-dedicated logging bucket (retention 90 days, exportable as CSV).
- KV / model artefacts: We will not persist customer training data; model KV caches are ephemeral and cleared on session end or after 8 hours of inactivity.
- Key Management: Customer-managed keys supported for Dedicated; for hosted pilot we can offer a customer-provided KMS integration (bring-your-own-KMS) scoped in the SOW.
- Access: Role-based access limited to named SREs and one engineering contact; we can generate an auditor API key with read-only access to audit exports for a 7-day window.

Action items for Helio: confirm whether you require customer-managed cryptography for pilot; if yes we need the KMS account details and time to run a short KMS validation (3 business days).

Regards,
Priyom Das
Head of Security Engineering
Redwood Inference
[Attachment referenced: redwood-subprocessor-map.csv]

From: Alice Barnes <alice@heliohealth.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@heliohealth.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, priyom_das@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial TIA scoping & UK addendum sequencing for HelioHealth pilot

Rishi / team — this is very helpful, thanks. Procurement confirms we can accept the 90-day debug log retention for the pilot; legal will review your tracked comments today and aim to return a signed UK Addendum by Nov 16. On KMS — we will opt to use HelioHealth-managed keys for the pilot; I'll have our infra contact share the account details and a burner key for validation by end of day Nov 12.

Two quick asks before we close the loop: 
1) Can Redwood produce a one-page evidence statement we can attach to our vendor assessment that summarizes the items Priyom listed?
2) Please provide the DocuSign envelope once the Addendum is updated so our signatory can execute quickly.

If you can get the one-pager and updated Addendum to me by Nov 12 morning (PST), we should be able to meet the legal milestone.

Thanks — Alice
Alice Barnes
Head of Legal Operations, HelioHealth
[References: procurement ticket #HH-2026-849]
